chapter: Manuel Perez and the roof garden
title: Identifying musicians in photos in Charters's book
summary: Williams and Allen puzzle over who is in a Tuxedo Jazz Band photo, guessing at Emmett Scott and Joe Watson of Ridgely's band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Oh, we were looking at this book here. It's called Jazz New Orleans, 1885 to 1957 by S.B. Charters. That's my boy.
Well, anyway, you got the original tuxedo jazz band. You were looking at the tuba player here. Let's get the glass on it so you can see.
And who did you say that was? It looked like little Emmett Scott. What's his name? Emmett Scott was a guitar player, wasn't he?
Emmett Scott was a guitar player. Yeah, like you said before. It's Ellie. That's what you called him's nephew.
A guitar player from up there away. Oh, what is his name? That's who it looked like to me because he had a horn like that and played, you see? Little Ellie.
But they don't say on there.
It says Jesse. Jesse what? No, it just says Jesse. That's all I want to tell you. And that saxophone player in the middle, I don't know who they are.
Well he's off the boat, I don't know him from St. Louis you see. I don't know him. Between Durbany. Yeah, between Durbany. He's unknown saxophone. And Robert Hall.
